body.condition: Every eigenvalue of every matrix occurrence \(R(M)\) in \(\mathfrak T_{\mathsf A}(P)\), including each singleton encoder query, belongs to \(\{0\}\cup[g_0,\infty)\).

novel.justification: This is a pre-sampling model promise on a named public computation path. It is realized with constant \(g_0\) by the uniformly conditioned bipartite family in Theorem 2 even though an unqueried subset is exponentially ill separated.
